verdict.rationale: The evidence shows investors and legal teams get a real-time view of ownership and reporting. Nothing documents a data room, document storage or sharing, granular access permissions, or a diligence-ready package for counsel and investors. The fund-admin investor portal (KYC, performance reports) is an adjacent feature, not a permissioned diligence data room.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can share a permissioned, diligence-ready data room — cap table views plus underlying documents — with counsel and investors
